f.title: Maintain a PV system for marketed products
f.statement: MAHs are responsible for ensuring the safety of their products by maintaining a pharmacovigilance system to monitor product safety while the product is on the market.

rows.quote:
Responsible for ensuring the safety of their products by implementing
(MAHs)                                   pharmacovigilance activities that include:
                                         ✓ Maintain a pharmacovigilance system to monitor product safety when the
                                           product is in the market.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to include the section 4 lead-in 'Responsible for ensuring the safety of their products by implementing pharmacovigilance activities' (with the '(MAHs)' table-column fragment kept verbatim), which supports the statement and the Mandatory level. Rows 0002-0005 rely on the same lead-in. Double-check: confirmed. Below 90: Mandatory rests on the table lead-in 'Responsible for ... activities that include' (judgement on level), and the quote carries the '(MAHs)' table-column fragment.

f.title: Report ADRs and safety concerns from the manufacturer to MFDA in a timely manner

rows.quote:
Report ADRs and safety concerns received from the manufacturer to

rows.review_note: Review: no change. Level Mandatory rests on the section 4 lead-in (quoted in row 0001). Confirmed: the guideline sets no MAH-specific ICSR timeline; 'in a timely manner' is the only MAH timing, and MAH reporting is otherwise deferred to the product registration guideline (7.2.2(c)). The 24-48 h / one-week timelines in 7.4.1 apply to healthcare professionals and patients only and are not curated. Double-check: confirmed. Below 90: the bullet has no modal and its quote lacks the 'Responsible for ...' lead-in (row 0001); 'in a timely manner' is unquantified.

f.title: Report serious/non-serious ADRs, lack of efficacy and misuse situations
f.statement: Reporters shall submit information on: serious or non-serious suspected ADRs or AEs, known or unknown, associated with therapeutic goods; lack of therapeutic efficacy, particularly for vaccines, contraceptives, antibiotics or medicines used in critical or life-threatening conditions; and adverse outcomes from overdose, misuse, abuse, off-label use, occupational exposure or medication errors.
f.applicability: Applies to reporters generally; MAHs are named reporters in 7.2.2(c) and (e).

rows.quote:
Reporters shall submit information on the following situations:

7.3.1    Serious or non-serious suspected adverse drug reactions (ADRs) or adverse events (AEs),
         whether known or unknown, associated with the use of therapeutic goods.

7.3.2    Lack of therapeutic efficacy, particularly in the case of vaccines, contraceptives, antibiotics,
         or medicines used in critical or life-threatening conditions.

7.3.3    Adverse outcomes arising from overdose, misuse, abuse, off-label use, occupational
         exposure, or medication errors involving therapeutic goods
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed. Below 90: 'Reporters' is generic; application to MAHs relies on 7.2.2(c)/(e).

f.title: Include the five key elements for a valid report
f.statement: To be valid and assessable, a report must include: an identifiable reporter; an identifiable patient (name, age, sex or unique identifier); a suspected medicine; a suspected adverse reaction; and a plausible time relationship between administration and onset.
f.applicability: Applies to reporters generally; MAHs are named reporters in 7.2.2(c) and (e).

rows.quote:
To ensure the report is valid and assessable, the following five key elements must be
         included:

                 a. An identifiable reporter (e.g., healthcare professional or facility),
                 b. An identifiable patient (name, age, sex, or unique identifier),
                 c. A suspected medicine,
                 d. A suspected adverse reaction, and
                 e. A plausible time relationship between drug administration and reaction onset.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed five elements. Below 90: actor not named in the quote (inferred from the reporting section, which addresses all reporters).

f.title: Risk management must characterise safety, plan PV and implement minimisation
f.statement: The key components of risk management shall include characterising the product safety profile including known and unknown aspects; planning PV activities to detect new risks and further characterise existing ones; and implementing risk minimisation and mitigation activities and assessing their effectiveness.

rows.quote:
The key components of risk management shall include:

                  • characterizing the safety profile of the medicinal product, including both known
                      and unknown aspects.
                  • Planning pharmacovigilance (PV) activities to detect new risks, further
                      characterize existing risks, and deepen knowledge of the product’s safety
                      profile.
                  • Implementing risk-minimization and mitigation activities and assessing their
                      effectiveness.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed text. Below 90: the quote describes components of risk management without naming who acts; MAH actor and the duty reading are inferred.

f.statement: MAHs shall submit a Risk Management Plan for the company describing the risk management system implemented for registered products, including its objectives, routine risk minimisation activities and risk communication measures.

         MAH for registered medicinal products and shall include:

                  • The objectives of the risk management system

                  • Details of routine risk minimization activities

                  • Risk Communication measures
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed: quote names MAHs, 'shall submit' and the required RMP contents.
